Verse Engine blog#

Plain-language posts about what Verse Engine does, how it does it, and what each release means for the people who use it. New posts are added here and linked from the product page.

Posts#

  • Verse Engine 2.7: what's new for you — 2026-10-10. Lighting, BIM files, phone AR and voice tours, explained without the jargon. What each new feature means for a client visit.
  • How Verse streams a 3-million-triangle building into your browser in seconds — 2026-10-01. The problem with 3D files, the streaming idea borrowed from video, the measurements, what is new in 2.0 and what comes next. Written for everyone.
  • Verse Engine 2.0 — release notes for humans — 2026-10-01. What you can do now, what changed if you were already using Verse, and what is still beta. The short version of the changelog.

Writing for this blog#

Posts are Markdown files in docs/blog/, rendered by the docs site at /docs/#/blog/<file-name>. Add the post here and to the sidebar list in web/playground/docs/index.html (title, date and a one-sentence description — the description becomes the page's search snippet and social card). Diagrams are inline SVG in a ```svg fence. Keep the language plain: if a sentence needs a glossary, link the concepts page instead of explaining the internals.
